{"metadata":{"description":"An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Harness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes.","id":"gh:1333955952","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-progressive-tools","slug":"Yan-Zero/dsh-progressive-tools","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Har"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-progressive-tools"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Har"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes. It keeps the model-visible tool prefix stable whi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"le the live ToolRuntime catalog may register, unregister, restrict, or shadow non-eager tools."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Installation and composition"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Follow `INSTALL.md` and install this standalone bundle into a dsh profile. Its bundle patch mounts t"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"he plugin once on the host plane, whose scoped ToolRuntime and SystemPrompt views carry it into ever"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"y existing and future Agent preset. No preset copy, preset edit, or preset selection is required. Th"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"e plugin requires `tools`, `systemPrompt`, and `llm`; `codeRuntime` is required only when an agent a"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ctually presents Code Mode. It never patches the Harness checkout."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The configuration block above is an optional override in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; the bundl"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e already owns the `progressive-tools` row. `eagerTools` contains exact, genuinely stable tools that"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" remain declared directly. Unknown eager names fail assembly. Every count, grapheme, and rendered UT"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"F-8 result limit is enforced before a successful discovery result returns."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Stable mode surfaces"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Effective mode | Stable model-visible tools | Invocation after describe |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Native, native deferred API | `search_tools`, `describe_tools`, eager tools | ordinary tool call w"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ith the returned exact name and arguments |
| Native, other API | `search_tools`, `describe_tools`, "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"`invoke_tool`, eager tools | `invoke_tool({ name, arguments })` |
| Code | `run_code`; its SDK decla"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"res discovery and eager bindings | `toolsexactName` inside a later `run_code` |
| Both | `run_code`,"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" discovery tools, eager tools | ordinary tool call or Code binding |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`invoke_tool` is a capability fallback, not a second Code transport. The plugin removes it at the pi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"-ai request boundary when the resolved model supports OpenAI Responses client tool search or Anthrop"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ic tool references. Code and Both already have `run_code`, so they never expose `invoke_tool`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Discovery protocol"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. Call `search_tools({})` or `search_tools({ query: "*" })` directly in Native/Both, or as a Code b"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"inding in Code mode, to list the complete lightweight catalog. Each entry contains only the exact `n"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ame` and a bounded `description`, matching Harness Skills' summary-first shape. A text query is an o"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ptional ranking filter: terms are matched independently instead of all being required, and a zero-ma"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"tch query falls back to the complete catalog. An explicit `limit` still narrows a response when desi"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"red.
2. Call `describe_tools({ names })` for the candidates you intend to use. It returns their cano"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"nical input/output schemas and full descriptions; Code/Both also receives the active-runtime SDK exc"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"erpt.
3. On a later model step, a natively capable API emits an ordinary tool call using that exact "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"name and arguments. The plugin reconstructs successful `describe_tools` results from durable request"},{"id":"p14s10","text":" history and injects their schemas at the matching tool-result position. A Native API without that c"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"apability calls the stable `invoke_tool({ name, arguments })` fallback. Code calls `toolsexactName` "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"from a later `run_code`.
4. ToolRuntime resolves the current scoped registry at execution time. Exis"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ting visible tools run normally; removed, restricted, shadowed, or misspelled names return the curre"},{"id":"p14s14","text":" run normally; removed, restricted, shadowed, or misspelled names return the current failure reason."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Search and describe use `ctx.tools.schemas(exec.agent)` and `ctx.tools.get(name, exec.agent)` on eve"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ry call. Search returns only `name` and `description` entries plus compact count metadata; describe "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"returns exact schemas only for selected names. Neither result exposes internal catalog or presentati"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"t schemas only for selected names. Neither result exposes internal catalog or presentation metadata."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The protocol keeps no mutable reveal set: search does not unlock a capability, and the complete runt"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ime catalog remains the execution authority. Native disclosure is reconstructed from logged `describ"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"e_tools` call/result pairs on every request."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Native API injection"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Harness request objects stay frozen and read-only. The plugin uses the public `llm/stream` waterfall"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" to carry one request's durable disclosures, then reversibly wraps the resolved pi-ai `Models.stream"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"Simple` instance. For capable models it adds pi-ai `addedToolNames` to the matching result and suppl"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ies the disclosed schemas; pi-ai serializes OpenAI `tool_search_call`/`tool_search_output` or Anthro"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"pic `tool_reference` blocks at that transcript position. Unsupported or unrecognized adapters are le"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ft untouched and retain `invoke_tool`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Model experience"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Native"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **The native bridge is feature-detected against pi-ai internals** — DSH exposes a read-only stream"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" waterfall but no adapter context-transform hook. The plugin therefore wraps the current pi-ai Model"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s instance without changing Harness source. If that internal shape changes, it fails open to the sta"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ble `invoke_tool` fallback; Both continues to have `run_code`.
- **Native capability metadata must b"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"e accurate** — OpenAI Responses uses `compat.supportsToolSearch`; Anthropic uses `supportsToolRefere"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"nces` or pi-ai's first-party model rule. A gateway that over-claims either capability may reject the"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" injected protocol.
- **Presentation is not authorization** — callers that already know an exact nam"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"e may try it; ToolRuntime visibility, policy, approval, guards, and scheduling remain authoritative."},{"id":"p23s9","text":"
- **Independent `tool:*` guidance is not filtered** — a plugin that dynamically changes separate gu"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"idance text can still change the system prefix.
- **Complete prompts remain authoritative** — Harnes"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"s restores a complete prompt after the assembly waterfall, so discovery guidance cannot be injected "},{"id":"p23s12","text":"there even though the stable wire projection remains.
- **Search is relaxed deterministic lexical ra"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"nking, not semantic retrieval.** Independent-term matching, identifier splitting, and small English "},{"id":"p23s14","text":"plural normalization improve recall; a query with no lexical candidate returns the complete lightwei"},{"id":"p23s15","text":"ght catalog instead of an empty dead end.
- **One cooperative presentation owner per scope is assume"},{"id":"p23s16","text":"d** — two plugins that both rewrite the final tool surface have no merge contract."}],"truncated":true}
